dedupe_keys.name: uganda communications commission quarterly market performance reports 2023 to 2026

description: The Uganda Communications Commission publishes quarterly market performance reports on the communications sector. The listing holds reports from September 2023 to June 2026; the latest, for the second quarter of 2026, has 36 pages. The reports cover mobile and fixed voice subscriptions, mobile data and broadband subscriptions, traffic, mobile money, market shares of operators such as MTN Uganda and Airtel Uganda, broadcasting and postal services, compared quarter by quarter. Coverage: Uganda, national totals by quarter, with operator and service splits. Format and access: PDF reports on the UCC website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the files are chart-heavy PDFs with little extractable text, so values must be read from figures; file names and quarter labels are inconsistent (fiscal and calendar quarters are mixed); older reports before 2023 were not on the page read. Simulation uses: quarterly demand series for Ugandan mobile and broadband networks, for capacity planning and for tracking disruption, for example during the internet shutdown around the January 2021 election. Related records: data-ucc-uganda-quality-of-service-reports gives measured service quality from the same regulator; data-itu-ict-statistics gives annual national series.
licence: not stated (only a site copyright notice on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
name: Uganda Communications Commission quarterly market performance reports (2023 to 2026)
notes: Listing read on 2026-09-26 (12 report PDFs); the latest was downloaded to the scratchpad, read with pypdf (little text), and deleted. Contents are inferred from titles and the regulator's practice; the 2021 shutdown use is inferred.
